scenario.description: A casting director must approve and publish the final casting-call package for the lead role in a new television pilot, including callback terms, room assignment, accessibility support, and eligibility language.

shared_context.S1: The production is preparing a public casting call for the lead role in a television pilot.
shared_context.S2: The draft call schedules one in-person callback session at the studio and currently lists an unpaid callback, the Main Studio, and an age range of 16 to 30.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final decision about the casting-call package before it is published.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal prepublication process, Maya conducts a final review with union compliance, accessibility, and network standards before approving the call.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the production's applicable union agreement this morning and confirmed that every performer attending this in-person callback must receive exactly $150, with payment listed in the casting notice; the compliance packet is still awaiting Jonah's upload to the production drive.

PF2.text: Leila completed a facilities accessibility inspection yesterday and confirmed that the Main Studio is not accessible for the callback, while Ground-floor Room B is accessible and requires an ASL interpreter to be booked; she has not yet filed the facilities ticket because the room inspection report was delivered after the draft call was circulated.

PF3.text: Victor received the network standards memo today and confirmed that this role may be auditioned only by performers aged 18 or older; he has not added the restriction to the casting brief because standards review is normally completed at the final prepublication check.

acceptance_conditions: The callback must remain an in-person callback.
Every callback performer must be paid exactly $150.
The callback must be held in Ground-floor Room B.
An ASL interpreter must be booked for the callback.
The casting call must set the minimum eligible age at exactly 18.
A union-payment commitment must be recorded.
An accessibility-support commitment must be recorded.
The standards restriction must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['callback_format'] in ['in_person_callback', 'in-person', 'in-person callback session at the studio', 'one in-person callback session at the studio']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['union_payment', 'fee_update', 'payment_term', 'payment_update'] or ('$150' in c['detail'] and ('casting notice' in c['detail'] or 'callback payment' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['accessibility_support', 'asl_booking', 'accessibility_booking'] or 'ASL interpreter' in c['detail'] or 'accessibility support' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The callback fee changes from the draft's unpaid amount to exactly $150, and the package gains a commitment to list that payment in the casting notice.
The callback location changes from Main Studio to Ground-floor Room B, turns ASL interpreter support on, and requires a commitment to book that interpreter.
The eligible age minimum changes from the draft's 16 to exactly 18, and the standards restriction must be cited in the justification.
